lines: # Folder map
What each folder is for. Read this before adding a file.
- `sources/`: Everything cited or consulted (`index.md`, `pdfs/`, `web/`, `data/`).
- `sources/pdfs/`: Papers and reports as downloaded. Read-only, never modify.
- `sources/web/`: Saved pages with URL and access date. Read-only, never modify.
- `sources/data/`: Datasets as received. Read-only, never modify.
- `notes/`: Your own words about the sources (`reading/`, `synthesis/`, `scratch/`).
- `notes/reading/`: One note per source, named by citation key.
- `notes/synthesis/`: Themes, comparisons and claims with source keys.
- `notes/scratch/`: Loose thoughts. Disposable, safe to clear.
- `outline/`: Structure and argument, versioned by filename.
- `drafts/`: Working text, one file per section.
- `analysis/`: Notebooks and scripts that compute results.
- `figures/`: Charts and diagrams (`src/` scripts and editable files, `out/` exports).
- `figures/src/`: Scripts and editable files that make the figures.
- `figures/out/`: Exported figures referenced by the drafts.
- `tables/`: Table data as .csv and rendered tables.
- `citations/`: `references.bib` and the citation style file.
- `reviews/`: Feedback and responses, one folder per round.
- `build/`: Compiled PDF or HTML and aux files. Ignored by Git and disposable.
- `published/`: Final versions as released, dated, frozen.

purpose: `{{project}}` is a research and writing workspace.
rules: - Each folder's purpose is in `FOLDERS.md`; read it before adding a file.
- Every source gets a citation key, a line in `sources/index.md` and an entry in `citations/references.bib`.

- Never edit downloaded or received files in `sources/pdfs/`, `sources/web/` or `sources/data/`; the only file in `sources/` you may change is `sources/index.md` (add one line per new source and keep its entries up to date).
- Every factual claim in `drafts/` carries a citation key; no key, no claim.
- Never cite a source that is not saved in `sources/`.
- A direct quote is copied exactly and includes a page or section number.

- Scripts that draw figures live in `figures/src/`; scripts that compute results live in `analysis/`. Figures in `figures/out/` are produced only by something in `figures/src/`; never hand-edit an export.
- Drafts in `drafts/` are edited in place; never edit an outline in place, save every change as the next file (`outline/outline_v02.md`, `outline/outline_v03.md`).
- Changing `brief.md`, the central argument or the section structure needs approval.
- `published/` is written once per release and never edited afterwards.
- Run `git lfs install` once before the first commit.
